# BUGS — queue learnings

Workers read this file before claiming and append to it when they finish.

- Pagination bugs in the admin list are almost always a filtered/unfiltered count mismatch — check the count query first.
- The webhook retry worker and the scheduler both send; dedupe on delivery id, never on payload hash.
- OAuth 401s right after a deploy are the signing-key race between old and new workers, not bad sessions.
- Prefer a failing smoke test before touching `app/routes/` — the suite is fast and catches regressions here.
